displayName.zh: 新致汽车新灵AI营销智能体

description.zh: 专为汽车行业打造的 AI 营销智能体 —— 新致新知汽车行业大模型、全网车型库、行业知识智能检索、实时热点趋势与多渠道营销内容生成，为消费者选车购车决策、企业洞察市场趋势、内容创作提供全方位智能服务
description.en: An AI marketing agent purpose-built for the automotive industry — powered by the Newtouch automotive industry LLM, it unifies a full-coverage vehicle database, intelligent industry knowledge retrieval (RAG), real-time trend intelligence, and multi-channel content generation to deliver end-to-end intelligent services across consumer car-buying decisions, enterprise market insights, and content creation.
